assessed_non_auction_sources.Andersons: Andersons Estate Agents (Sheffield) states on its own current services page that it does not conduct property auctions and instead works with a local auctioneer; it is therefore not an independent auction-house catalogue target.

policy: Every required source must have a collector, an explicit current-catalogue-pending status, or a verified successor-source alias after acquisition/rebrand. Published future commercial/mixed-use catalogues must reconcile before production is considered complete. Expansion sources must be assessed and activated wherever qualifying public inventory exists; leads verified not to operate an independent auction catalogue belong in assessed_non_auction_sources rather than blocking acceptance.
